an3.86:1.1: bhikkhave diyaḍḍha-sikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha atthakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.
an3.86:1.2: Tisso imā bhikkhave sikkhā yatth' etaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati.
an3.86:1.5: Imā kho bhikkhave tisso sikkhā yatth' etaṃ sabbaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati. 2.
an3.86:2.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattaso kārī paññāya mattaso kārī.
an3.86:2.2: So yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi.
an3.86:2.4: Na hi m' ettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā.
an3.86:2.5: Yāni kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyikāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhita-sīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.86:2.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano. 3.
an3.86:3.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattaso kārī paññāya mattaso kārī.
an3.86:3.2: So yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi.
an3.86:3.4: Na hi m' ettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā.
an3.86:3.5: Yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyikāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.86:3.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakid eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassa antaṃ karoti. 4.
an3.86:4.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya mattaso kārī.
an3.86:4.2: So yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi.
an3.86:4.4: Na hi m' ettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā.
an3.86:4.5: Yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyikāni brahmacariyasāruppāni, tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.86:4.6: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti, tattha-parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā. 5.
an3.86:5.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī.
an3.86:5.2: So yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi.
an3.86:5.4: Na hi m' ettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā.
an3.86:5.5: Yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyikāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.86:5.6: So āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.86:6.1: Iti kho bhikkhave padesaṃ padesakārī ārādheti paripūraṃ paripūrakārī.
an3.86:6.2: Avañjhāni tvevāhaṃ bhikkhave sikkhāpadāni vadāmī ti. 86. 1.
